name: Adam
source:
A man of valor and heroism, as well as the first human ever created... though not quite the same Adam the world at large knows. He was re-imagined by the angels for the purpose of helping them turn the tide of battle at Tokyo Babel.

His inability to read the mood is beyond compare, while his drought of emotions exceeds even that of Setsuna. To him, feelings are a redundant element in achieving his goal ? as such, he lacks any and all kinds of emotions. And yet, one can find an exception to everything in life: for instance, goals achieved through disaffectionate methods might hold little meaning for a being inevitably endowed with feelings from birth.

Adam is the sole person in Tokyo Babel whom Setsuna regards with rejection and contempt.

[Source: [url=http://www.mangagamer.org/tokyobabel/]MangaGamer[/url]]
